# MDL007 mdl-version

Missing version header, unsupported major, or files of one model with different majors.

## What it does

A file with a missing or unsupported header is refused whole and never parsed on a guess.

## Why it matters

The version header names the grammar the file is written in. Reading a file on a guess would change what it means between releases, so a file without a usable header is refused whole.

## Remedy

Start the file with `grimble = "2";`, and keep every file of one model on the same major.

## Examples

### Fires case 1

```grmb expect=fire file=design/model.grmb
module m;
node a : trusted {
}
```

### Clean case 2

```grmb expect=clean file=design/model.grmb
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted {
}
```
